An original young woman with long, dark brown
hair arms herself with a cross-armed pose in a
gravel lot. She wears a hot pink one-shoulder crop
top and a hot pink satin mini skirt with a quilted
cream panel. Her expression is calm and friendly.
Bright, sunny daylight with blue sky and a low
building behind her. Palette of hot pink, cream, and
sky blue. Bold and sporty, in the style of a summer
